neighbours.label: first- and second-person possessives (my, your) in personal or advice talk about one's own body, family or work
fire: After the long run I could feel my legs shaking for hours.
If you sit at a desk all day, your back will start to ache.
I am so proud that both my daughters finished university this year.
Before the interview, make sure your shoes are clean and polished.
The doctor told me that my blood pressure was slightly high.
When you get stung, your skin may swell and turn red.
I spent the whole weekend painting my kitchen a pale yellow.
The only way to improve is to do your homework every single night.
